bio: A Strategic Human Resource Consultant with 15+ years of experience in the NGO sector, specializing in talent acquisition, people development, and organizational capacity building to drive performance, strengthen leadership, and achieve sustainable organizational growth.
Expertise in recruitment strategies, skill-based workforce training, employee engagement, talent development, and purposeful team motivation.

services.title: Strategic Recruitment & Talent Acquisition
services.description: Recruitment solutions designed to identify suitable candidates based on organizational needs, role requirements, competencies, and cultural fit.

services.title: Workforce Training & Development
services.description: Practical training and orientation programs designed to improve employee competencies, confidence, motivation, and professional performance.

services.title: Employee Engagement & Team Motivation
services.description: Strategies to strengthen workplace engagement, improve morale, support employee retention, and build productive teams.

services.title: Flexible HR Consulting
services.description: Consulting engagements available on an hourly, weekly, monthly, or project basis — structured around your organization's needs.

pricingNote: Project-based consulting fees are determined by scope and deliverables, agreed in advance with each client.

approach.title: Understand Organizational Needs
approach.description: Listening closely to leadership and teams to map goals, culture, and constraints before recommending any action.

approach.title: Identify Capability Gaps
approach.description: Assessing current HR practices, workforce skills, and structures to pinpoint where targeted intervention will have the most impact.

approach.title: Design Practical HR Interventions
approach.description: Building recruitment, training, or engagement plans that are realistic for the organization's size, budget, and timeline.

approach.title: Support Implementation & Evaluate Progress
approach.description: Working alongside teams through rollout, then reviewing outcomes and adjusting the approach as needed.

contactInboxNotice: Inquiries are reviewed personally and typically answered within 2 business days.
